Name: Mycology (Mushroom Trees)
Author: aviroen
Description:
[size=6][b]Mushrooms?! Mushrooms!
[/b][/size]
A mushroom-themed expansion with cooking recipes and questionably drinkable tapper items.

This will be a perpetual project whenever I feel like adding more mushrooms.

//a69c-4e24-b8abac1214f6

[quote][b][size=3]﻿How do I get the seeds?[/size][/b]
You can find the flowerpot next to the Hat Mouse, hides a secret warp.

[b][size=3]What is Trypophobia Toggle?
[/size][/b]For those who don't like trypophobic-images (real world beehives, wasp nests, etc), you will not receive the Stinkhorn seed!

[b][size=3]Can I suggest mushrooms?
[/size][/b]Sure! I am currently working from [url=https://www.boglarchamp.ro/en/10-beautiful-and-special-mushrooms-from-around-the-world/]this list[/url]﻿ in my spare time.[/quote]
[quote]﻿[size=6]Future Implementation:
[/size][s]Probably a whole different area that has a shop to have all of my seeds, as well as showcasing all of the trees in their full form. (because I'm getting tired of adding maildata)[/s] [s]﻿[/s]Done
If I'm really crazy, a friend-able mushroom NPC.
If I'm REALLY REALLY crazy, a romanceable mushroom NPC.[/quote]
